summary_en: 200,000 shares (0.86% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-19 at ¥1,745/share, upper limit ¥349.0M. Block execution in single morning session. Cumulative acquisitions under the May 2026 authorization totalled 177,000 shares (¥260.9M) as of 2026-08-18.
title_en: Notice of Share Buyback via Off-Hours Matching Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: TENTIAL Inc. announced on 2026-08-18 that it will execute a specific block acquisition of its own shares under the May 2026 share buyback authorization. The company will place a buy order via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours matching transaction) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange at 08:45 on 2026-08-19, using the day's closing price of ¥1,745/share. The block is capped at 200,000 shares (0.86% of outstanding shares excluding treasury) with a total upper limit of ¥349 million. The order is valid only for that single trading session; results will be published after 08:45 on 2026-08-19. As of the filing date, cumulative acquisitions under the broader buyback program (authorized 2026-05-22 through 2026-08-31, total cap ¥1 billion for up to 600,000 shares) had reached 177,000 shares for ¥260.9 million. A 3-for-1 stock split became effective 2026-07-01, adjusting the nominal share counts retroactively in this disclosure.
